metadata.description: This node captures a deliberate distortion of designated international aid. Funds originating from the US Government / White House, explicitly intended for Restitution / Rehabilitation, were systematically redirected through local financial institutions under a fictitious USAID gateway. Concealment Mechanism: The assets (~$1.4M USD / 25,210,256.15 MDL) were initially processed by Moldindconbank, routed through the State Bank of Moldova, and ultimately delegated to FinComBank utilizing the protection cover of Irina Oleinic. Fraudulent Re-designation: The aid was falsely reported before the US Congress as funding for Moldovan penitentiary institutions and border security, thereby masking the extraction of non-round, fragmented sums.
